target.statement: GATED-LWCal mean ECE = 0.122 (and NLL = 0.396) over 432 noisy random-forest cells, vs raw RF ECE 0.188
target.dataset: Nine local scikit-learn/synthetic binary tabular tasks (Breast Cancer, Wine 0/2, Digits High/Even, Iris, 3 synthetic)

compute.basis: Paper reports the full 432-cell RF study runs in ~6 min on a 96-thread host using only local sklearn datasets and 160-tree forests; on 8 cores expect ~20-40 min, all CPU.

title: LWCal: Loss-Weighted Calibration for Tabular Classifiers with Noisy Calibration Labels
